note: Three delivery windows a day, the same for everyone wherever they live. One hour wide, so the customer gets a promise they can plan around instead of a per-street estimate that moves. Each closes an hour before it starts, which is the shopkeeper's picking time.
capNote: 25 orders a slot is a guess, not a measurement. It is what stops a single window being oversold; raise or lower it once there is a week of real load. A full slot is shown as full rather than hidden.
parked: There used to be a fixed tempo route here with per-locality arrival times, traffic factors and baked road geometry. It is in parked/ -- the driver works out his own order from the addresses, which is what actually happens, and a one-hour window is a promise that survives traffic.
